entities.summary: Shoshoni, also written as Shoshoni-Gosiute and Shoshone, is a Uto-Aztecan language from the Numic branch spoken in the Western United States by the Shoshone. Shoshoni is primarily spoken in the Great Basin in areas of Wyoming, Utah, Nevada, and Idaho.
